sources.title: Clothing of a Civil War Soldier
sources.use: Representative kepi, sack coat, trousers, brogans and natural fabric context; not regiment-specific certification.

sources.title: Accouterments of a Civil War Soldier
sources.use: Representative knapsack, blanket, canteen, leather ammunition equipment and rifled-musket/ramrod context. Four samples do not establish a complete historical drill.

reviewLimits: Historical kit placement and proportions are model-assisted representative interpretation; independent human and knowledgeable historical review remains pending.
